evidence_slice: Greater London Authority publishes a Custom Polygon GIS dataset titled Old Oak and Park Royal Development Corporation Boundary, with an OPDC-shp ZIP distribution under Open Government Licence v3. The current London City Hall OPDC page confirms that OPDC is a statutory Mayoral Development Corporation established to secure regeneration of the Old Oak Opportunity area across Ealing, Brent and Hammersmith & Fulham, including the Old Oak development area around the HS2 Old Oak Common Station. The establishment decision states that OPDC would plan for significant future growth at Old Oak and promote physical, social, economic and environmental regeneration.
